name: Ascension...
label: Quest
description: Ascension...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.
Take it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.
You will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is merely dragon-talk, friend - more hot air than actual substantive information. Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.
